entities.name: Yuki-Onna
entities.description: Powerful elemental spirit of cold and frost on Kamigawa residing in the Heart of Frost.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Imprisoned the yuki-onna in a tile and stole part of her power, embedding it in a kanji on his forehead.

entities.name: Uramon
entities.description: Leader of the men who pursued Toshi.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: Led Uramon's men; reluctantly helped Toshi imprison the yuki-onna.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: Led Uramon's men; reluctantly helped Toshi.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Received the tile from Toshi and handed it to Godo.

entities.name: Godo
entities.description: Released the yuki-onna in Sokenzan against Konda's samurai.

entities.name: Uyo
entities.description: Soratami who suggested the moonfolk's revenge; killed by Toshi with the yuki-onna's power.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: Intervened to show Toshi he was deluded by the moonfolk.

entities.name: Heart of Frost
entities.description: Mountain in the Tendo Peaks where the yuki-onna resides.

events.summary: Toshi uses the yuki-onna to get rid of Uramon's men pursuing him.
events.quote: The yuki-onna was used by Toshiro Umezawa to get rid of Uramon 's men led by Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer

events.summary: Toshi imprisons the yuki-onna in a ceramic tile and embeds part of her power in a kanji on his forehead.
events.quote: Toshi imprisoned the yuki-onna in a ceramic tile and stole part of her power

events.summary: Toshi gives the tile to Hidetsugu, who hands it to Godo; Godo releases the yuki-onna in Sokenzan.
events.quote: Godo released the yuki-onna in his territory of Sokenzan.

events.summary: Appearing as princess Michiko, the yuki-onna decimates Eiganjo troops, then turns on Godo's own men.
events.quote: Appearing as princess Michiko to the Eiganjo troops, she decimated the daimyo's men.

events.summary: Forced by the soratami's revenge, Toshi reverses the spell, kills Uyo with her power and frees the yuki-onna to her original realm.
events.quote: Then, he broke the final kanji, and the yuki-onna was reinstated in her original realm again.

relations.quote: using her power for the last time to kill Uyo
